_about: ReceptionFlow — example business profile for the reusable voice-agent template. This is FICTIONAL EXAMPLE DATA (Lumen Salon), used only to show every field the template and its tools expect. See docs/client-onboarding.md for how to create a real profile for a new client, and docs/voice-agent.md for how each field is used by the system prompt and the 7 tools in config/vapi-tools.json. Keys starting with an underscore are documentation-only; a real profile doesn't need them.
_industry_note: Free text, but keep it short — it's spoken in the greeting (e.g. 'a salon', 'a dental clinic', 'a gym'). Other examples: clinic, gym, spa, coaching_center, restaurant.

contact.directions_note: Ground floor, next to Cafe Leaf, opposite the metro station exit. Parking is on the street; there is no dedicated lot.

break.note: Staff lunch break — no walk-ins or appointments seated during this window.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays; the agent should mention this is possible but not guess specific dates unless told.

services.name: Haircut
services.description: Wash, cut, and style with a senior stylist.

services.name: Haircut and beard
services.description: Haircut plus beard trim and shape-up.

services.name: Hair colour
services.description: Global or partial colour; product and technique vary by hair length and condition.

services.name: Consultation
services.description: One-on-one consultation to plan a cut, colour, or style change.

price_policy.disclaimer_note: Prices may vary with hair length, product used, or stylist seniority — always add this note when quoting anything other than a flat exact price.

faqs.question: Do you accept card and UPI payments?
faqs.answer: Yes, we accept cash, all major cards, and UPI.

faqs.question: Do you take walk-ins?
faqs.answer: Yes, walk-ins are welcome, but booking ahead means less waiting.

faqs.question: Is parking available?
faqs.answer: Parking is on the street only; there is no dedicated lot.

availability._source_options: google_calendar | staff_roster | not_tracked — see docs/voice-agent.md for how each is handled by get_availability.

booking._bookable_services_note: Hair colour (svc-color) is intentionally excluded here — this business only takes colour bookings in person, so the agent should offer a callback/lead request for it instead.
booking._confirmation_channel_note: Placeholder — no SMS/WhatsApp provider is connected yet. See docs/voice-agent.md.

callback._notify_channel_note: Placeholder — where the business is notified about a new callback/lead request. Not wired to a real provider.

additional_triggers: requests for a specific chemical treatment's safety or allergy risk
requests to negotiate or discount a price beyond what's listed

restricted_topics: medical, allergy, or health claims about any product or treatment
discounts or pricing not listed in services or price_policy
anything about staff not listed in availability.staff
